items.title: Christian Watson: Managing rib soreness ahead of Week 9
items.text:
Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Works off to side during practice Monday
items.text:
Skattebo (hamstring) was spotted working out off to the side during the Giants' unofficial practice session Monday, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Pursuing return to NFL
items.text:
Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Activated for Monday night game
items.text:
The Seahawks reinstated Price (chest) from injured reserve ahead of Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Could be game-time call for Week 9
items.text:
Giants head coach John Harbaugh said that Skattebo (hamstring) is day-to-day and could end up being a game-time decision for Sunday's tilt with the Eagles, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
